## Checklist

- [ ] One task, atomic commits, Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test:cov` (100%) and `npm run size` pass
- [ ] No runtime dependency added; the public API changed only on purpose (major if breaking)
- [ ] `contract/openapi.json` synced when the batch format changed
- [ ] Behavior verified in a real browser
- [ ] README and ADRs updated when touched
- [ ] Nothing personal can leave the browser through this change
